title: Stop refuses unproven clauses exactly as the proof line counts them, and accepts clauses that already hold
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115h2: four rows merged with clauses 0/N proven (e.g. clauses 0/5 at /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/krn/.krn/runs/outside/npm.log:400) although t-k031r25 made the clauses arm default; and py-bug blocked because a clause test could not be red at base despite clauses 4/4 red-first 1 (py.log:451-452).
Outcome: one reader decides clause proof for both Stop and the proof line; Stop refuses while any clause lacks a passing test; red-at-base is required for at least one test of a fix/feature, not for every clause (a clause already holding at base is proven by a passing test).
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/brain/acceptance-clauses.ts, src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts, tests.
Proof: regression tests on verbatim npm.log:400 and py.log:451 captures are red before the fix; outside npm and py rows rerun show clauses N/N on every merged lane.
